description: This PHP class defines a data model for representing the latest attendance record of an employee, including details about punch-in and punch-out times, employee info, and attendance state. It is used within the OrangeHRM system's attendance plugin API.

classes.name: EmployeeLatestAttendanceRecordModel
classes.description: A PHP model class that normalizes attendance record data, including punch times and employee info, for API output.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the model with an AttendanceRecord entity and sets up data filters and attribute mappings for serialization.
